notes: δέκα καὶ ὀκτώ is one unit on *eighteen* under rule 94's count test; assigning the whole word to ὀκτώ and emptying δέκα and καί is the competing reading, but *-teen* answers to δέκα. Rule 29 keeps numerals separate only where the ASV writes separate words.
The italicized *these* is added under rule 5, no demonstrative standing in the projection.
